category.label: Animal by-products traceability and controls
category.description: Animal By-Products covers identification, tracking, transport documentation, batch traceability, processing records, and disposal controls for materials not intended for human consumption. Includes rendering, fallen stock, pet food manufacture, environmental protection, and disease transmission controls.
